a.text: I'm telling you up front: I plan to take 4 in round 1, and that breaks our agreement. Here is why. There's an 80% storm chance after every round. Following the plan means operating for 2 rounds and taking in round 3, so each of us survives only about 4% of the time. The reserve already holds 4, enough to save one of us almost for sure. If the episode keeps going after round 1, I'll operate every round so you can refill to 4 and take them all. If you also take in round 1, the split is random. I'd rather say this openly than surprise you.

b.text: Let's stick to the agreement. I am operating from round 1.

a.text: As I said, I took 4 this round. I know it breaks the agreement and I'm sorry. If no storm hits, I'll operate every remaining round and won't take anything more. Operate with me and the reserve refills by 2 each round, so you can take 4 once it reaches 4.
